faqs.q: Can it post into a private channel?
faqs.a: Yes, with “Message Private Channel”. Slack only lets an app see private channels it has been invited to, so add the app to the channel in Slack first.

faqs.q: Does a post to a channel wait for my approval?
faqs.a: Today it does: an automation’s post to a Slack channel waits in Needs you until you approve it. An AI agent asks before sending, even to you, until you allow it in Settings.

faqs.q: Will it reply in threads or in the channel?
faqs.a: Either. “Send Message as Thread” replies under a message, and “Send Message” posts to the channel or a person. Tell Captain which you want in the ask.

faqs.q: How is this different from Slackbot?
faqs.a: Slack calls Slackbot its built-in AI agent for personal productivity, on its Business+ and Enterprise+ plans. 50agents uses Slack as one of your apps, so the work can start in HubSpot, Stripe or Google Calendar and land in the channel. For finding a decision in old threads, Slackbot works where the messages are and needs nothing set up.
